'''''ATS-0157''''' was a [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards, Inc.]] [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] that was owned and operated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. ''ATS-0157'' was assigned to the [[Defiance Task Force]], and carried a cargo of [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]], presumably brought aboard during the evacuation of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].
